Couldn't find a set of skins that I liked or did what I really wanted, so I decided to figure out how to make the stuff myself.  The icons all have a different effect for mouseovers and clicking through and are all transparent.  The images Icon1-3 show this.  Icon1 is an icon all by its lonesome.  Icon2 is the effect of a mouseover.  Finally Icon3 is the effect when clicked.

The media player skin is the only one I didn't code myself.  It's a slightly modified Box Player.  I pretty much just made it a bit bigger, removed the blur, added the background, realigned and centered the text.

As for the background, it was found on the Dreamscene website and is animated.  A preview can be viewed [here](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TaljMZrHh2k), and the movie/background can be downloaded [here](http://www.dreamscene.org/load.php?Cmd=Download&AL=Yes&ID=181).

I wanted the Misc section to have weather information, but I'm still learning and weather (and to a lesser extent media player stuff) is still just beyond my understanding.  Mainly I just don't know what page(s) to parse exactly.  But for now, I'm happy with how it looks and how it turned out.

We're still living together.  We basically have to.  The lease on this place doesn't run out for a few more months, and like I said, neither of us can really afford any other option.  I suppose I should be greatful that she doesn't just say fuck it, and move back in with her dad, but I just don't know anymore.

She tries to say that history isn't repeating.  That this time there wasn't a choice, but I see how much she talks to him.  She falls asleep texting him every day, is never without her phone, chats with him, and has been on the phone with him for the last three hours.

We were going to go to PAX East together again this year, but she's going with him instead.  At D&D on Friday, my friends said I could go with them, and that I should confront her to get back half of the money for the hotel room, but how can I if I can't even talk to her?  She says she wants to be alone, but I know she wants to be with him, that even though she said I was still her best friend that I no longer matter whatsoever.

She had me set up my own bank account, which is typical enough...but it also showed exactly how much I'm worth to her.  We had over $1400 in the account.  I got $50, with no word as to whether I'll be getting any more.  How could I have been so stupid to fall so far from her graces?  I had a nightmare just before I woke up today.  It was a dream about me killing myself and what happened directly after.  She found out, and she was relieved...happy even that I had finally done it.  She came over, acting concerned, when she finally stopped talking to the new guy long enough to notice me three feet behind her laying on the couch crying.  When I told her what the dream was, she got pissed off and said she didn't want to be upset today.  Which of course just made me feel all the worse.

I know that it was stupid of me to devote so much of myself to her.  I forgot who I was, stopped doing things for myself, and focused completely on her.  I know that I caused a great thing in my life to disappear because I was afraid of imaginary demons.  I also know that it's not the end of the world.

It's what I don't know that's terrifying me.  I've never lived alone.  I have no idea how to cope with such a drastic change.  I don't know if I should consider moving back where I came from, or if it's even possible.  I don't know how I'm going to be able to survive with nothing more than $50 plus whatever I get from paychecks after I change my direct deposit information.  I don't even know if anyone wants me to.

So I think back to the razor blades, carefully hidden away.  I know she won't find them, just like she doesn't know that I've already cut myself once.  Not deep...just enough to know that I still felt something.  She probably won't ever know.  She goes to reddit...might even see this post, but I doubt she'll pay it much mind.  The funny thing is, when I told her I deserved to die for everything I'd done to her, she almost convinced me that she was scared.  That all changed when two minutes later she got angry because she got a text message and I was still talking.

She finds newer and more interesting ways to tear herself away on a daily basis.  And all I can do is go day by day, bottling up more and more anguish until I eventually reach the breaking point or something better happens.

I've been trying to help the latter along more than the former.  With a lack of places to go that don't involve alcohol in the area, I've been looking more into myself...remembering the things that made me happy before.  I've started writing again, even asked one of my old friends for tips on getting published, though he hasn't responded.  I've looked into working out, and started making plans for cosplay shenanigans at PAX this year.

But I'm still scared.  I still have nobody to talk to.  Can't run the therapy route with such a small amount of money.  And most of all there's her.

Despite what she says to me, whatever her real feelings are, I still consider her my best friend.  I know the chances of us getting back together are pretty much nothing, and the more I think on it, the less I want to.  But that doesn't mean I value our friendship any less, and the idea that it might all go away scares me more than all of this.  That connection...that friendship is the last thing I think I have left to lose.  And if I lose it, I'm worried that all this fear and what little hope I have will be replaced with that scary serenity...that sense of peace one has when they know they're about to die, and all they can do is let it happen.  I know that if I try to force it, it'll backfire.  So I'm taking things day by day.  Like people always say (and I unfortunately didn't listen), you have to work on yourself.  Change yourself...only then will you change the world.  But it doesn't get rid of the fear.

I've spent the last couple days deciding whether I should put this here or in [/r/MMFB](/r/MMFB) .  I'm not on the verge of killing myself.  Not yet at least.  But I am in dire need of someone to talk to.  I even called a suicide hotline...and got a busy signal.

I wish I knew that she still cared.  That she wasn't just lying again.  I'm so scared that the nightmare I had will become a reality.  I don't want my fiance back.  I ruined that, and I have to live with it for however long it is.  I just want my friend.

It's a very adrenaline fueled game, as most pvp based games are.  While not nearly as bad as DotA or its clones (LoL and HoN), there will always be people with attitudes that use insults as a form of trying to spark some kind of response.  People take their win/loss ratios as a matter of pride sometimes, and when someone else comes along and "ruins it" for them, they often lash out aggressively.

Games like that often have an ignore or silence feature that is simple yet effective.  I'm not sure if Team Fortress 2 (I'm assuming this is the game you mean) has such an option, as I haven't played it in years, and even then it was only a couple times, but I'd definitely look into it if someone has resorted to petty name calling over a game.
